To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the CWI's of the 4-point functions of a CTF are solved in d spacetime dimension by a unique class of hypergeometric functions that are at the same both conformal and dual-conformal.
the CWI's for scalar 4 point function of primary fields in d dimensions are solved by generalized hypergeometric solutions.

the conformal Ward Identities (CWI's), in momentum space, of scalar 4-point functions of primary fields, admit a unique class of solutions which are simultaneously dual conformal and conformal in any d.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the study of exact and approximate solutions of the CWIs of 4 point functions, which are at the sametime dual conformal and conformally invariant, and their relation with generalized hypergeometic systems.
the study of the conformal and dual properties of 4 point functions and their connection with the conformal Ward identity.
the study of the hypergeometric solutions to the conformal Ward Identities of scalar 4-point functions, in momentum space.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hypergeometric solutions are the only ones which are both conformally covariant and dual conformally invariant.
the conformal and dual symmetry of the 4-point correlator in momentum space is a sufficient condition for a hypergeometric solution to be exact.
the conformal Ward Identities are sufficient to characterize and classify the class of hypergeometric functions that can appear as solutions of the conformally covariant correlators.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in momentum space the CWI's for scalar 4 point function in d dimensions are solved by generalized hypergeometric series of 2 or 3 variables.

we have shown the possibility of solving exactly the conformal Ward identity for 4 point functions with hypergeometric functions and we have shown that in the large energy limit this can be done with the Lauricella functions.
the conformal Ward Identities in momentum space are solved by hypergeometric functions, which are also solutions of the dual conformal equations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CWI's of scalar 4-point functions are sufficient to identify specific solutions of the conformally invariant correlators in momentum space.
the conformal Ward identity of 4 point functions is sufficient to determine the exact form of the solutions of the conformally covariant correlators, in any spacetime dimension, in momentum space.
the hypergeometric solutions to the CWI's are not only a feature of the planar limit of the conformal 4 point function.
